name: DFW Cubing Winter 2025
information:
Note: This competition is on a Sunday.

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2025#48388-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.*** 

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
